ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 92% low-intensity (black/dark gray) background pixels with 8% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels appearing as discrete points and lines.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Sparse distribution of small white circular blobs across both lobes; gray-to-white mottling is concentrated in the interior region adjacent to the median notch. Linear white streaks are densely mapped across the central and lower-mid sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees at the central lobe junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits a high-amplitude macro-excision (deep notch) at approximately 30% of the distance from the tip to the center; the right lobe shows more uniform, low-amplitude micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory; the right lobe maintains a more continuous arc while the left lobe's sweep is interrupted by significant edge irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (~5-12 pixels in diameter) scattered bilaterally; prominent clusters are located in the upper-right quadrant and middle-left section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, white, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across both lobes, with high density in the lower-central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular macro-excision/trauma mark located on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, small white ring-shaped pixel structure is visible in the middle-right quadrant of the right lobe surface.
